run_prepare_coco_point_annotations: run the script to generate point-based supervision for COCO dataset with N points per instance
run_get_point_annotations: run get_point_annotations to convert COCO segmentation masks into sampled point coordinates and labels
build_point_supervision_from_coco: build point-based annotations from a COCO JSON file by sampling random points within each instance bounding box
refactor_get_point_annotations: refactor get_point_annotations to support custom point sampling strategies beyond uniform random within bounding boxes
review_mask_conversion_logic: review the mask conversion logic that handles polygon, uncompressed RLE, and RLE segmentation formats
